title: fix(settings)!: offer the knowledge settings only where the knowledge service is mounted
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33933

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#4569
(Parked as a draft by seat ruling: the hosted runtime's service-ai embedder binding reads `ai.embedder_*` without mounting service-knowledge (cloud lane answer 6902349823 on #33933). This PR lands after cloud#4569 retires that hosted binding. Card comment 6906109461.)

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a deployment that does not mount `KnowledgeServicePlugin` (every stock boot), `GET` / `PUT /api/settings/knowledge` and `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` answer `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`; a write of an `ai.embedder_*` key answers `400 UNKNOWN_KEY`; `POST /api/settings/ai/test_embedder` answers `400 SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED` (no handler registered); the hub list drops `knowledge` and the Setup sidebar drops `nav_settings_knowledge`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the knowledge settings page or the `ai.embedder_*` keys; `skills/objectstack-ai` teaches wiring `KnowledgeServicePlugin`, which is unchanged.

**BREAKING** for a deployment that does not mount the knowledge service: the Knowledge page, the AI page's Embedder section, their two test buttons and the Setup entry are no longer offered by default. They come back, unchanged, when `KnowledgeServicePlugin` is mounted beside `SettingsServicePlugin`. Stored `knowledge.*` / `ai.embedder_*` rows are untouched. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 not-required marker (no-migration-prescription).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:知识库设置页、AI 页的「Embedder」分区、两个测试按钮和 Setup 菜单项,改为只在挂载知识库服务时出现;默认部署不再显示。
- 为什么改:知识库不是默认能力,以前每个部署都显示一个背后没有服务的知识库页面和测试按钮,误导管理员。
- 风险与回滚:未挂载知识库服务的部署,这些设置接口改为返回 404 / 400;已存的值仍在库里,挂载服务后照常回来。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-settings-contribution.ts`(注册逻辑,尤其 ai 分区只并入内置 ai 清单那段)、`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts`(Embedder 分区拆出)、`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service-plugin.ts`(optionalDependencies 保证设置插件先初始化)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run src/__tests__/knowledge-settings-contribution.test.ts`,预期 7 个用例全绿(挂载有、不挂载无)。
- 需要你做的:落地前由席位向云端车道确认:托管环境的 embedder 绑定会挂载知识库服务,或不依赖 `ai.embedder_*` 读取。

## What changes

- `@objectstack/service-settings`
  - `builtinSettingsManifests` drops `knowledgeSettingsManifest` (10 → 9).
  - `aiSettingsManifest` drops its embedder section; the section is exported as `aiEmbedderSettingsSpecifiers`, with `withAiEmbedderSection(manifest)` to join it (idempotent).
  - The default `actionHandlers` map no longer registers `knowledge.test` or `ai.test_embedder`.
  - The package entry exports `knowledgeSettingsManifest`, `knowledgeTestActionHandler`, `aiSettingsManifest`, `aiEmbedderSettingsSpecifiers`, `withAiEmbedderSection`, `aiTestEmbedderActionHandler`.
  - `settings.ai.description` no longer names the knowledge base, in all 11 bundled locales.
- `@objectstack/service-knowledge`
  - New `contributeKnowledgeSettings(ctx, version)`, called from `KnowledgeServicePlugin.init()`. It registers the `knowledge` manifest and `knowledge.test`, and joins the embedder section plus `ai.test_embedder` to the `ai` namespace. It joins them only when the served `ai` page is the bundled one, or already declares the embedder keys. A host's own `ai` manifest is left untouched, and the plugin logs a warning saying why. It also registers the `nav_settings_knowledge` Setup entry as a `navigationContributions` bundle through the `manifest` service.
  - `optionalDependencies` names `com.objectstack.service.settings` (literal, ADR-0116), so "no settings service" at init is a fact of the composition.
  - Depends on `@objectstack/service-settings`; devDependency `@objectstack/platform-objects` for the merged-Setup-tree test.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: the static `nav_settings_knowledge` entry leaves `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS`. Its label stays keyed in the Setup bundles.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`: `builtin-apps-nav-render` (rev 16) and `settings-hub-roundtrip` (rev 9) restated for 9 builtins and the knowledge page's new source.

## Tests

- New `service-settings/src/knowledge-settings-default-absent.pin.test.ts` pins the default boot (8 cases, refusals by status + `error.code`):
  - no `knowledge` in the aggregate or the hub list;
  - `GET knowledge` answers 404 `UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`;
  - no embedder key or button on the served `ai` page;
  - `PUT ai {embedder_provider}` answers 400 `UNKNOWN_KEY`;
  - `POST ai/test_embedder` answers 400 `SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED`, judged against the hub's own no-handler answer, and `POST knowledge/test` answers 404 `UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`;
  - no knowledge Setup entry;
  - no locale's AI description names the knowledge base.
- New `service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-settings-contribution.test.ts` uses a LiteKernel with `KnowledgeServicePlugin` deliberately `use`d BEFORE `SettingsServicePlugin`, against a bare control kernel (7 cases):
  - the namespace, the embedder keys and both actions are there with the service and absent without it. The actions are judged equal to their handler's own answer.
  - on the merged Setup tree (ObjectQL registry fold), `nav_settings_knowledge` appears exactly once with the service and never without it;
  - the two HTTP-door cases moved here from `settings-default-action-handlers.pin.test.ts`.
- Updated:
  - `ai.manifest.test.ts`: the embedder describe reads the exported section; a joined-parse and idempotence case is added.
  - `settings-default-action-handlers.pin.test.ts`: the population excludes the two moved buttons.
  - `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` and `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`: the corpus keeps the knowledge declarations, so the measured 10 manifests and 90 predicates and the copy coverage still hold.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 3 (a mounting app): no app in this repository mounts `KnowledgeServicePlugin`. The test kernel above stands in for one, as ruled; `examples/app-todo` is unchanged.
- **Hosted embedder use is the cloud lane's question.** Before landing, the seat confirms with the cloud lane that the hosted embedder binding either mounts the knowledge service or does not read `ai.embedder_*` without it.
- The refusal codes at the HTTP door are `UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` / `UNKNOWN_KEY` (the route envelope's spelling of the service's `UnknownNamespaceError` / `UnknownKeyError`).
- Surface deviations, both required by the approved dependency:
  - `packages/services/service-settings/src/index.ts`: the package entry exports the six symbols listed under What changes.
  - `packages/services/service-knowledge/vitest.config.ts`: src aliases for `service-settings`, `types` and `platform-objects`, as `check:test-source-alias` requires.
- The two corpus tests (`settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts`, `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`) were outside the listed files too. They are measurement pins over this package's declarations, updated so they keep measuring the same declarations.

## Verification

All verify runs go through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and quote the lock's `VERDICT command-exit 0` line. Final head is `f27aef7db8`: `1b210ee4f6` plus a merge of `origin/main`.

<details><summary>Ablation of every pin (on-disk mutation via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, WRAP restore, restore proven blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Tests are src-aliased, so no dist leg is needed.

- A1, knowledge manifest back in `builtinSettingsManifests`: red, 5 failed.
  - Absent pin: aggregate/hub list, `GET knowledge` 404, both test-button doors.
  - Default-action-handlers pin: the population, and "every declared action reaches a handler".
  - The first A1 attempt was a no-op, refused by the tool because its replacement contained the anchor. It was redone as A1b.
- A2, embedder section back on the served `ai` page: red, 4 failed (no embedder key/button; `PUT embedder_provider` 400; population; handler reach).
- A3, static `nav_settings_knowledge` back: red in the absent pin (stock nav) and in the knowledge suite (the merged tree holds the entry twice when mounted, once when bare).
- A4, `en` AI description naming the knowledge base again: red, 1 failed (locale description).
- A5, default `actionHandlers` registering `ai.test_embedder` again:
  - First run: GREEN. No pin covered an extra handler, so the door pin "neither test button reaches a handler" was added.
  - A5b after the pin: red, 1 failed.
- A6, `contributeKnowledgeSettings` not called: red, 6 of 7 failed (only the bare-hub non-vacuity case stays green).
- A7, `com.objectstack.service.settings` dropped from `optionalDependencies`: red, 6 of 7 failed. `use` order alone does not put settings first.
- Every leg: `ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD`, and `_DIFF_HEAD_LINES=0` at the end.
</details>
